html:
G'oya

Do'stlik ikki tomonlama, jadvalda esa bir tomonga yozilgan. Avval har bir qatorni ikkala yo'nalishga yoyamiz: (a, b) va (b, a). UNION bu ishni qiladi va bir vaqtda takrorlarni olib tashlaydi: (1, 2) va (2, 1) yoyilgach ikkalasi ham (1, 2), (2, 1) beradi, UNION ulardan bittadan qoldiradi. Keyin har bir foydalanuvchi uchun juftliklarni sanaymiz.

Yechim

WITH f AS (
  SELECT user_id AS a, friend_id AS b FROM friendships
  UNION
  SELECT friend_id, user_id FROM friendships
)
SELECT u.id, u.name, COUNT(f.b) AS friends
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN f ON f.a = u.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.name

LEFT JOIN do'sti yo'q Sardorni ham saqlaydi. COUNT(f.b) uning uchun 0 beradi, chunki NULLlarni sanamaydi.

Tuzoqlar

UNION ALL takrorlarni qoldiradi. Namunada (1, 2) va (2, 1) ikkalasi bor, shuning uchun Malika Azizning do'sti sifatida ikki marta sanaladi: Azizda 4, Malikada 3 chiqadi.

Noto'g'riWITH f AS (
  SELECT user_id AS a, friend_id AS b FROM friendships
  UNION ALL
  SELECT friend_id, user_id FROM friendships
)
SELECT u.id, u.name, COUNT(f.b) AS friends
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN f ON f.a = u.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.name

Faqat user_id bo'yicha sanash Dilnozani unutadi: u faqat (4, 1) qatorida, lekin Aziz ham uning do'sti, Dilnoza ham Azizning do'sti.

COUNT(*) LEFT JOINdan keyin do'sti yo'q foydalanuvchiga 1 beradi: NULLli bitta qator baribir qator.

Boshqa yo'l

UNION ALL qilib, COUNT(DISTINCT f.b) bilan sanash ham to'g'ri. Yoki har bir foydalanuvchi uchun korrelyatsiyalangan subquery ichida o'sha UNION:

SELECT u.id, u.name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
          SELECT friend_id AS x FROM friendships WHERE user_id = u.id
          UNION
          SELECT user_id FROM friendships WHERE friend_id = u.id
        ) t) AS friends
FROM users u
